, starring and directed by , is probably the weirdest Tom Cruise movie you'll see this year. A satirical disaster movie about an oil tycoon, environmental catastrophe and the absurdity of power, Digger takes a very unexpected turn that completely changes what you think you're watching.
In this episode of Firstpost Presents: First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews and analyses Digger, breaking down the performances, writing, visuals, satire, comedy, the big twist and everything that works and doesn't.
